title: Discover Emerging Crypto Projects with Binance Alpha 2.0: Now Available on the Binance Exchange
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We’re excited to introduce Binance Alpha 2.0, the next evolution of our platform. Binance Alpha 2.0 integrates Binance Alpha directly within the Binance Exchange, bridging the gap between centralized (CEX) and decentralized (DEX) trading. Binance Alpha 2.0 is currently in BETA and is only available to users from a few selected regions. The product will gradually be released in more regions in the coming days as we ensure optimal performance and user experience.About Binance Alpha: Binance Alpha was  announced  on 2024-12-17 as a platform designed to spotlight early-stage projects with potential to grow within the web3 ecosystem. Some tokens highlighted on Binance Alpha may be considered for future listings on Binance Exchange, while not guaranteed.  Tokens featured on Binance Alpha are selected using Binance’s industry expertise and advanced insights, spotlighting those that demonstrate strong community interest, growing traction, and alignment with key trends shaping the crypto ecosystem. What Is New in Binance Alpha 2.0: Binance Alpha 2.0 expands Binance Alpha by integrating it directly within the Binance Exchange, while still remaining available on the  Binance Wallet . This innovative solution bridges the gap between centralized (CEX) and decentralized (DEX) trading, enhancing liquidity, capital efficiency, and accessibility for users. Key features include: Binance Exchange integration:  Users can explore and purchase tokens on-chain directly on the Binance Exchange; No web3 wallets required:  Users don’t need to create an on-chain wallet or withdraw assets to external wallets;  Utilize exchange funds:  Users can utilize funds from their Spot, Funding, and other accounts supported by Binance Pay; Seamless trading:  Experience DEX trading with a simplified interface.   Explore Binance Alpha 2.0 Now! Please note: Binance Alpha is an educational initiative and does not constitute an endorsement or guarantee of listing on Binance Exchange. Tokens are selected based on various factors, including community interest, traction, and market trends. How to Discover and Trade on Binance Alpha 2.0: Navigate to  [Markets]  and choose  [Alpha] . Tapping the  [Trade]  button directs you to the trading page. Enter the amount you wish to spend, and the system automatically calculates the amount of tokens you will receive,  after deducting network fees incurred by on-chain transactions . Prices update every 15 seconds, ensuring fair and transparent transactions.   Before completing a trade, you must review and accept the disclaimer for ‘Alpha Trading.’ Once confirmed, proceed to the checkout window to finalize the purchase. Tap  [Confirm] . After the payment is submitted, the order status will be changed to “Processing”. Transactions are executed quickly, however, few transactions may fail due to rapid market price changes.   You can track your past and pending orders under the  [Alpha History]  section. Note: Currently, only USDT and USDC are supported (depending on the user’s region). Support for additional assets will be added gradually. From  2025-03-17 08:00 (UTC) to 2025-09-17 08:00 (UTC) , all trades conducted through Binance Alpha will enjoy zero trading fees. However, please note that users must still cover the network fees incurred by on-chain transactions. Stay Informed: Follow Binance Wallet’s official social media channels and keep an eye on the Binance Wallet homepage for regular updates on Binance Alpha.  Together, we’re creating a more informed and engaged crypto community. Important Notes:  Tokens on Binance Alpha may pose a higher than normal risk, and will likely be subject to high price volatility. Users must exercise sufficient risk management and DYOR (do your own research) to fully understand the projects before opting to trade the tokens.
